But today I'm finally writing a review because I can't get an appointment for my daughter as they don't answer the phone! 111 advised getting an appointment with a GP for her within the next hour and I was left hanging at number 1 in the queue position for over 45 minutes! I ended up having to hang up and rung the same day health centre instead who answered straight away and got an appointment for in 2 hours time! I'm only being generous with 2 stars for the sake of their lovely Health Care Assistant, Sharon, who will allow extra time to discuss medical concerns during treatments and is always happy to see you.
